summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a routine management information circular for its annual general and special meeting scheduled for June 16, 2026. The meeting covers standard items: receiving audited financial statements, fixing the number of directors at five, electing directors, appointing KPMG LLP as auditors, and approving an amended share compensation plan. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. This is a routine meeting notice with no market-moving catalyst.
